**Title: That Wasn’t My Blanket**
*(funny hospital country-comedy)*

**Verse 1**
I was hunting for a seat in the waiting-room zoo
Saw a blanket on a chair, thought “that girl’s saving two”
I go “mind if I sit?” she goes “darl I wouldn’t know”
So I dumped it on the floor like a crime-scene tableau

Then the nurse rolls up in gloves like he’s defusing a bomb
“Is that *your* blanket?” I go “mate, that’s not even my blood, calm”
I sanitised my hands like I’d just robbed a bank
Freaking out — “please tell me it hasn’t got vomit on the flank”

**Chorus**
It wasn’t my blanket, it wasn’t my blood
Just another Tuesday in the hospital flood
Heart rate doing cardio I never signed up for
Potassium drink tasting like regret and floor
Sister turns up with her drip, family reunion in the ward
Nurse goes “who was that?” “I think that’s her sister, lord”
It wasn’t my blanket — but it’s my life, I guess
Coffeebreak comedy, medical mess

**Verse 2**
They tried to take my blood, I made it an adventure
Showed Darko the needle, thought I’d be a good mentor
She couldn’t even look — worst motivational speech
Turns out fear is not a teaching method, peach

“Skull it faster, faster,” Darko coaches the cup
Potassium’s the villain, glucose can shut up
Haven’t eaten since yesterday, still not discharged
Just monitoring my ticker like it’s overdue and large

**Chorus**
It wasn’t my blanket, it wasn’t my clot
(Well they thought it was a clot, then they said maybe not)
Canula still in, don’t you dare forget
I want a warm bath, charged phones, and clothes that aren’t wet
Keen to go home but the meals slap, I’m not gonna lie
Hospital selfie, drip chic, living my best “why”

**Bridge**
Mum says “you’re supposed to be the mother”
I’m shouting like a personal trainer, not a lover
Kids behave for grandparents — of course they do
I’ve got no deep voice, I don’t look like sweet gran yet, it’s true
Told her get dressed, stop the spoilt-brat show
Then panicked the neighbours might call the cops, you know

And God — WHY WON’T YOU WAKE HER UP FOR ME, AMEN
Also I still want that adult cubby house. Amen again.

**Final chorus**
It wasn’t my blanket, it wasn’t my blood
Just a girl in a waiting room doing the best she could
Suno in the pocket, Kick on the side
Prayer videos stacked like a spiritual hard drive
If you find a mystery blanket, leave it on the floor
Wash your hands, tell the nurse, and don’t ask anymore

It wasn’t my blanket.
But the song is mine.

It wasn’t my blanket.
But the song is mine.
